summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the election of Ms. Luciene Pandolfo as Chief Legal Officer by the Board of Directors, effective June 17, 2026. The filing confirms her appointment as a management change, with no financial terms or shareholder vote involved. Ms. Pandolfo holds a law degree and MBA, with over 20 years of experience in legal management across oil, gas, and telecom sectors; she replaces a prior officer. No recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. The change is routine and non-transformational; there is no risk-arb angle or pending transaction. Investors should note continuity in legal leadership.
